segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ דָּג טָמֵא שֶׁבָּלַע דָּג טָהוֹר, מוּתָּר בַּאֲכִילָה, וְטָהוֹר שֶׁבָּלַע דָּג טָמֵא, אָסוּר בַּאֲכִילָה, לְפִי שֶׁאֵינוֹ גִּידּוּלוֹ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of «a non-kosher fish that swallowed a kosher fish, consumption» of the kosher fish is «permitted. And» in the case of «a kosher» fish «that swallowed a non-kosher fish, consumption» of the non-kosher fish is «prohibited due to» the fact «that» the host fish «is not» the place of «its development.»

positions.claim: a swallowed fish follows its own status; the swallowed non-kosher fish is forbidden
